note: Town of Louisville campground on a grassy point of Fort Loudoun Lake (leased from TVA), bordered by Poland Creek; boat launch. Mostly seasonal: only one of its 31 electric sites (site 35) is sold by the night; the rest rent by the month or season, the lakefront ones included (18-31). No alcohol; gates closed 11 PM-7 AM. --Claude
summary: Poland Creek: town page (bot-walled live; June 2026 Wayback), the town's 2025 rate sheet and 2026 rules PDFs, Esri + 3DEP read. 31 electric+water sites, phone booking, Apr-Oct. Only site 35 is nightly ($50, 14-night max); every other RV site is monthly/seasonal -> long-stay DROP CANDIDATE (test 4). Lakefront rests on seasonal-only sites 18-31 -> downgrade to lakeview proposed if kept.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (long-stay, test 4 / test 2): the town's rate sheet sells every electric site by the month or season except one: 'Interior Sites: Sites 1-11, 16, 17, 32, 33, and 34 $500/ Month $3,325/ Season. Regular Sites: Sites 23-31 $575/ Month $3,850/ Season. Premium Sites: Sites 18-22 $600/ Month $4,025/ Season. 14 Day Max Rental Site 35 $300/ 14 Days $50/Night.' Rules: 'Monthly rent is due on the 1st of each month.' Nightly share: 1 of 31 RV sites (3%); even counting the unnumbered $30 tent sites (the June 2026 page now says all 31 sites have electricity, so they may be gone) it stays well under 1 in 10 of the RV supply. Local park, so no price gate; the one nightly RV site is $50. Google Maps 'Poland Creek Campground' (3804 Lowes Ferry Rd): 4.4 stars, 142 reviews, phone +1 865-257-6320 (read 2026-11-25; review text not shown to the logged-out browser).

WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview PROPOSED (if kept): the shoreline sites do pass the measurement - the west/south-west row sits ~10-20 m from Fort Loudoun Lake over open mown grass, pads 0.3-1.2 m above the 247.8 m summer pool by 3DEP - but the town names them '18-22' and '23-31' lakefront and sells all of them only by the month or season; seasonal-only sites don't earn the value. The one nightly site (35) is not located on any page. The whole campground is on the point within ~150 m of the water, so lakeview is supported. If AWH prefers to keep lakefront for the monthly row, replacement evidence: 'Town page/rate sheet: lakefront sites 18-31 (monthly/seasonal); Esri + 3DEP 2026-11-25: west-row pads 10-20 m from the water over open grass, 0.3-1.2 m above the 813-ft summer pool.'
